record.paper_title: Some open problems in the context of skew PBW extensions and semi-graded rings
record.original_question: Let B = ⊕_{n≥0} B_n be a semi-graded ring satisfying the conditions that B is left noetherian, B_0 is left noetherian, each B_n is a finitely generated left B_0-module, and B_0 is contained in the center Z(B). Assuming also that B satisfies the χ_1 condition, does the semi-graded analogue of the Serre-Artin-Zhang-Verevkin theorem hold, namely is there an equivalence of categories qgr − B ≃ qgr − Γ(π(B))_{≥0}?

evidence.quote: • Investigate the Serre-Artin-Zhang-Verevkin theorem for semi-graded rings.

The solution of Problem 1 is as follows. Theorem 1.24. Let B be a SG ring that satisfies (C1)-(C4) and assume that B satisfies the condition X1, then there exists an equivalence of categories qgr − B ≃ qgr − Γ(π(B))≥0. (1.10)

artifact.status_search_result: According to the source's own statement of Theorem 1.24, the question is resolved affirmatively: under conditions (C1)–(C4) together with the $\chi_1$ condition, the semi-graded analogue of the Serre–Artin–Zhang–Verevkin theorem holds, giving the equivalence $\mathrm{qgr}\text{-}B \simeq \mathrm{qgr}\text{-}\Gamma(\pi(B))_{\ge 0}$.
